summary: @or-sdk/flow-templates preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it against a bundled 727 KB sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-only bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io fingerprints (rotated string array `n7gIxM`, rotator `WV8StW`, alphabet-substitution decoder `hc1jfK9`) whose behavior is not statically inspectable and is not reachable from the advertised `FlowTemplates` SDK API in `dist/cjs/index.js`. The preinstall entrypoint `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x19328d`) and string-property indirection for constants such as `--version`, `ldd`, `/etc/os-release`, and the Bun download URLs. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time specifically to execute an obfuscated in-package payload that has no relation to the package's documented SDK purpose is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern; the code that ultimately runs on the installer's machine at `npm install` time is hidden behind the Bun bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
